lŏquēlāris , e, adj. loquela,
I.of or belonging to speech: praepositiones loquelares, in the grammarians, the inseparable prepositions, as re, se, dis, etc., Val. Prob. p. 1427 P.: am praepositio loquelaris significat circum, Paul. ex Fest. p. 4 Müll.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
